Ottoman Turkish طبان (taban)
Proto-Turkic *-če
Ottoman Turkish ـجه (-ca)
Ottoman Turkish طبانجه (tabanca)bor.
Arabic طبنجة
Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish طبانجه (tabanca, “pistol”), from طبان (taban, “sole of a foot”) + ـجه (-ca).
